# Test fixture policy

This directory contains only small, repository-owned inputs used to build test
fixtures at test time. `AndroidManifest.xml` is controlled plain XML; tests wrap
it in a temporary ZIP with an `.apk` suffix when manifest parsing is exercised.

Do not add third-party APKs, malware samples, production applications, secrets,
or large binary archives here. MinIO download behavior is tested with mocks and
small generated byte strings, so the test suite needs neither a real APK binary
nor a running MinIO server.

If compiled Android binary XML coverage is added later, document a reproducible
build process using a minimal repository-owned Android project and record the
required tool versions and source hashes. Generated APKs should remain outside
Git unless they have been reviewed as safe, license-compatible, and small.
